notes: Master Diag: persistent private flight recorder, shared controller/Dashboard event IDs, bounded retention and integrity checks, safe local investigations and a downloadable Codex-ready evidence ZIP. Source, prompts, model prose, manual notes and credentials are excluded by default; missing evidence and unproven causes stay explicit. Independent launcher records preserve startup/import/exit/update recovery evidence. Windows adds a current-user mascot desktop shortcut backed by a private stable launcher; physical Windows verification is still required. Generate Idea makes one isolated configured Ollama request, preserves edited input, and never starts a project. Existing projects, approved checks, consent gates and update rollback remain intact. Packaged build identity links reports to source bytes; fixtures do not prove live-model quality or GPU fit.
